title: WoTC Refuses Employee Union, 13 Omens Hits Crowdfunding, VTubers On Critical Role – TTRPG News 10/16/2026
summary: Wizards of the Coast does not recognize employee union, Dungeons & Dragons releases a module set in modern times, Paizo releases its own horror RPG on Kickstarter, and Critical Role announces a VTuber collab.
body_markdown:
Tabletop RPGs continue to become a bigger, more mainstream business, and with that come interesting opportunities and challenges. We see both in this week’s headlines: Wizards of the Coast does not recognize employee union, Dungeons & Dragons releases a module set in modern times, Paizo releases its own horror RPG on Kickstarter, and Critical Role announces a VTuber collab.


### **WotC Refuses To Recognize Union, But Will Heed Vote**


Wizards of the Coast is refusing to voluntarily recognize a union that’s forming from its designers and artists. Last week, a group of **DnD and MtG** employees[announced they were unionizing](https://startplaying.games/blog/posts/dnd-team-unionizes-dark-sun-graphic-novel-shadowrun-anarchy) under the name of **United Wizards of the Coast** . The group cited concerns over AI and lack of ownership over creative works as two of the primary reasons for uniting with the Communication Workers of America. They called upon WotC to recognize their union, but the company responded publicly this week with a refusal to do so. WotC argues that its best results are achieved by[“working directly with employees”](https://www.wargamer.com/dnd/mtg-union-not-recognized-by-wotc) but will still respect the union if it is voted for.


### **DnD Goes Modern With Technohorror Module**


via D&D Beyond


D&D Beyond launched[PROJECT_LAMORDIA](https://marketplace.dndbeyond.com/category/66W3ADY?icid_medium=organic&icid_source=homepage_lamordia&icid_campaign=2026_project_lamordia&icid_content=2026_hype&pid=DB66W3ADY) this week, an online-exclusive bundle that takes a **Ravenloft** setting into the modern day. In particular, it reimagines the Frankenstein-influenced Lamordia by shifting the mad science and body horror into a study on replacing humanity with robotics. The one-shot adventures take players through an abandoned lab populated by failed experiments, represented by new monsters that blend gothic horror with futuristic technology. Players can even be a human consciousness uploaded into a machine body, using the **Reborn species** from *Horrors Within* albeit with new origin prompts. The bundle costs $14.99.


### **13 Omens RPG Now Live On Kickstarter**


via Paizo


Paizo’s foray into **horror RPGs** is now available to[back on Kickstarter](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/officialpaizo/13-omens-a-horror-rpg) . It’s called *13 Omens* , and its design is far from that of[Pathfinder](https://startplaying.games/play/pathfinder-2e) or[Starfinder](https://startplaying.games/play/starfinder-2e) . Players make use of a shared dice bag that gains more **Omen Dice** as the session goes on. The Omen Dice naturally carry bad consequences, and so the tension ramps up organically alongside the story. *13 Omens* also promises to be more narrative, with each session being a self-contained one-shot story. The project is already fully funded with a month to go before it concludes.


### **Critical Role Collabs With VTubers For Daggerheart Series**


via Critical Role


Critical Role is joining forces with **hololive** for a six-episode actual play miniseries using[Daggerheart](https://startplaying.games/play/daggerheart) *.* Even more surprising is that the series is set in **Exandria** and is canon to the CR lore. **Matthew Mercer** will take the GM seat and the cast consists of **Marisha Ray with VTubers Nerissa Ravencroft, Mori Calliope, Shiori Novella, and Gigi Murin** . The series is titled[Shattered Legends](https://critrole.com/hololive/) and is set to premiere in November.


‍


Wild news on the last one, but it shows the reach of Critical Role and how popular VTubers are becoming outside their usual fandom! Thanks for reading, see you next week, and may your dice be kind.
